Seti Astro Suite Pro

V1.22.1
New Feature in ADBE: Multiscale Gradient Removal. This should not be used for normal gradient removal, but when you have a dust mote, filter edge, internal reflection, or other stubborn gradientesque object that needs to be removed. Use Exclusion Zones to protect your areas you want protected and run it to remove those very stubborn objects.

Update to BLINK to allow file list sorting by metrics columns.

Other updates and bug fixes.
